title: The Audit Log finds an entry by the Parts person's name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B, so that Labor and Parts hold different people.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and "Sales Representative - Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to sales rep B, where the Parts side was changed to sales rep B today, so the log has an entry for the Parts person.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order's menu.
  2. Click Audit Log.
  3. Search the log for sales rep B's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The log opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Sales representative changed" entry that set Parts to sales rep B is found.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S7-R3: “A split work order reads both sides, Parts first: "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)". An empty side reads "Unassigned", for example "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026
